recs.stt: Let’s not demonize driving, just stop subsidizing it
recs.x:
I basically just parroted Nathan Lewis, who has a great blog series on the topic: [link] .

It's virtually the same message from Andres Duany. His talk from 30 years ago is still so eerily precise and comprehensive: [link] . When I feel presumptuous, I email this to people (deaf ears, mostly). Leon Krier bangs the same drum, and adds a more sophisticated, architectural perspective: [link] .

cites.x: The New Urbanists have an interesting approach to this: “open source” planning codes that prescribe urbanism rather than sprawl, which they try to convince municipalities to adopt as their default.
